summary: Tested Ordini clienti/fornitori, evasione (parziale/totale/forzata con chiusura, carenze 409 + forza), DDT/BEM generation, annulla storno, impegnato/ordinato/disponibilita, client destinazioni (anagrafica + DDT editor + ordine), collapsible sidebar groups, mobile drawer, isolation and menu_off. Found 2 backend bugs and fixed both (details below): order creation always returned 500 (Decimal sent to Mongo), and cancelling a 2nd DDT/BEM on an order did not undo the order's evaded quantity. After the fixes, backend 20/20 and all UI flows passed.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: ordini._tot() returned decimal.Decimal (fatturapa.line_total returns Decimal) -> bson InvalidDocument -> 500 on every order creation. BEM costo_unitario had the same problem. Wrapped both in float() in ordini.py lines 65 and 206.

FIXED BY TESTER: query used {'evasioni.doc_id': X, 'evasioni.annullata': {$ne: true}}. In Mongo that means no array element may be annullata, so once one evasione of an order was cancelled, cancelling any later DDT/BEM never undid the order's evasa quantity or its status. The stock was reverted, the order was not. Replaced with $elemMatch on doc_id + annullata.

minor.issue: BEM number comes from find-max+1 without a company lock or unique index (the lock is per order: ev-{oid}). Two evasions on different orders at the same moment can get the same BEM number.
enrich() does not default giacenza to 0 for articles with no moves (key missing); the UI copes but the API is inconsistent.

issues: Page eyebrow says 'ARCHIVIO' although the item sits in the Magazzino group (pre-existing, cosmetic)

If the user collapses a group manually, the explicit false in nav_open overrides 'active', so navigating to a page in that group (e.g. from a link) leaves its group collapsed. Consider forcing the active group open.
Rows only have placeholders, no labels; fine but less clear once filled

action_items: Review and keep the two tester fixes in backend/ordini.py (float around line_total in _tot and BEM costo) and backend/ordini_core.py (storna $elemMatch)
Optional: protect BEM numbering with a company-level lock or unique index (company_id, anno, numero)
Optional: default giacenza to 0 in magazzino enrich(); keep the active sidebar group open even when the user collapsed it

rca of the issue: Bug 1: fatturapa.line_total returns Decimal; ordini.py stored round(sum(Decimal)) in imponibile, and pymongo cannot encode Decimal, so it failed with a 500 on insert_one. Reproduce: POST /api/ordini/cliente with any line. Fix: float(). Bug 2: create an order, evade it twice (DDT1, DDT2), cancel DDT1 (OK), then cancel DDT2: the stock is reverted but the order keeps evasa and its status. Cause: implicit array matching in storna. Fix: $elemMatch.
